text:
dave: Customer asked why audit NDJSON lacks a stable actor id for policy edits. They need to correlate editor across downloads.

nina: We currently only include actor.name. Raw internal ids are sensitive. Options: add reversible id (no), or pseudonym (hashed).

odden: Prefer pseudonym. Implementation: HMAC-SHA256 with per-tenant KMS key, include `pseudonym_version`. Non-breaking: field empty when disabled.

dave: UX: Compliance settings -> Export -> toggle "Include stable actor pseudonyms". Default OFF for trials. Toggle must be auditable.

nina: Telemetry: export.pseudonym_enabled, export.prepare_ms, export.hashing_ms, export.size_bytes. Add trace span prepare_export with tag pseudonym_count.

security-bot: Security ok with per-tenant KMS HMAC. Recommend key rotation plan, do not log raw pseudonyms. Document that older exports won't have pseudonyms; customers should re-run exports.

odden: Action: I'll bench hashing on 10M lines (2d) and open PR for API change. nina will add UI + FF (4d). dave to draft RFC and coordinate legal review.

dave: Thanks, bumping to product for enterprise opt-ins.
